patch_description: Improves on the current 26.25-score program in two ways: (1) the local search compares the full sorted KVPR vector lexicographically (all GPUs, not just top-3) and tries moves/swaps across *all* GPUs (any source, any destination), not just the hottest ones, escaping local optima the hottest-first strategy misses; (2) the multistart adds a perturbation phase that takes the best placement found so far, randomly relocates a few models, and re-refines — a simple iterated local search. All moves keep memory feasibility with `safe_ratio`/`1e-9` guards and iteration caps keep runtime tiny.
